exact_prompt:
Edit this exact full-canvas game diffuse texture into a modest HD hand-painted version. The attached image is the entire original 32x64 stored RGB canvas enlarged exactly by nearest-neighbor to 256x512. It is a strict UV map reference, not a rendered object illustration. Return the entire 1:2 canvas with every material field, black gap, outline, cut and weak lightpatch at exactly the same normalized position and scale. Do not crop, pad, frame, rearrange, zoom, or add whitespace.

Retain the very dark charcoal gray subtly purple painted metal palette. Preserve one long narrow stem and its dim longitudinal lightstripe, the separate right stepped polygon field, the lower painted circular ring with EXACTLY ONE existing dark opening, all the original short straight dark slots and existing stepped edge cuts. The small dark cross-shaped cut above the ring and short cuts below it are source geometry; keep their exact original shapes and positions. Do not add or remove any tooth, hole, rivet, marking, bolt or edge. Keep source dim broad shading and irregular silhouette; do not turn these painted shapes into photoreal three-dimensional hardware.

Only gently resolve the existing soft painted tonal detail. Many fields are almost flat and must stay almost flat. No invented surfacegrain, scratches, rust, new glints, bright rim, raised bevel, concentric engraved rings, decorative curls, logos, text, or symbols. Preserve original relative brightness, weak highlights, muted material and dark core. Output an opaque full UV canvas. Source alpha will be restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
